study type: Cross-sectional analysis of a population-based survey
cohort: 13,044 women who gave birth during the prior year using the public health system in the Amazon and Northeast regions of Brazil
finding: The overall MNM ratio was 31.5 per 1,000 live births, and several factors were associated with a higher risk of MNM, including indigenous ethnicity, longer travel time to the hospital, being refused by a full hospital, cesarean section, and public prenatal care.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a higher risk of MNM.
